settings.description: Admission for response-local Foundation-created style-element nonces; effective style-src-elem, style-src or default-src fallback source none remains denial.

semanticConstraints: Headers must contain printable ASCII with no control characters. CSP requires default-src, frame-ancestors none, object-src none and base-uri self/none; unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval are prohibited.
Permissions-Policy grammar and distinct directive identities are enforced by WebResponsePolicyCatalog.
PublicAssetMaxAgeSeconds zero means no-store; caching/indexing remains endpoint/application policy.

Static nonce sources and mixed none source lists are rejected. Foundation alone creates response-local nonces; final policy denial and errors discard contributions. Any issued nonce forces no-store even when the final policy discards it.
Final response writer owns X-Robots-Tag: private resources and errors deny both indexing and following; resource restrictions and named policy denials override permission.
